items.title: Türkiye’s share of global gold exports falls 72% after import curbs
items.author: Newsroom
items.excerpt: Türkiye’s share of global gold exports has fallen 72.4% since the final quarter of 2023, dropping to just 0.67% in the first quarter of 2026 as the country loses ground in a global market that more than doubled in dollar value. The decline follows restrictions on unprocessed gold imports introduced in August 2023 to curb the current account deficit, which have made it harder for Turkish exporters to compete in international markets, business-focused ekonomim.com reported. items.excerpt: The United States will renew support to international military operations in Somalia, the State Department told AFP on Sunday, reversing cuts that had threatened the survival of a coalition fighting Islamist insurgents in the country.
